scope: The 498-page cumulative paper develops a proposed cohomological approach to Riemann zeta zeros over the programme's tau base. It evaluates the original low boundary volume and high graded Gamma Euler term, constructs the native nonreduced conductor complex and low cohomology, and provides the invariant row recurrence and simultaneous spectral budget in the original Gamma inner products. A separate 13-page supplement gives the complete primitive-source, connecting-target and transport proofs. These controlled short corrections feed the original kernel/residual allocation; the common long loss and separate leading allocations remain uncomputed.
